data.name: Cat Mail Co.
data.shortDescription: Run a cozy cat post office. Sort and deliver parcels from the daily boat. At night, the moon reveals hidden truths about packages. Clear a strange backlog and unlock new destinations.

data.name: ISLANDERS: New Shores
data.shortDescription: Build your island retreat in a calm, minimalist world with exciting new features that keep the classic charm while inspiring fresh creativity.

data.name: Tiny Glade
data.shortDescription: A small diorama builder where you doodle whimsical castles, cozy cottages & romantic ruins. No management, combat or goals — just lovable dioramas.

data.name: Winter Burrow
data.shortDescription: A cozy woodland survival game about a mouse restoring their childhood burrow. Explore, gather resources, craft, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals.

data.name: Palia
data.shortDescription: A free-to-play fantasy life sim adventure where you can craft, explore, and create the life and home of your dreams in a vibrant, heartwarming world.

data.name: Tailside: Cozy Cafe Sim
data.shortDescription: Run your own cozy café in Tailside! Brew coffee, decorate your café, follow small stories in the daily newspaper. Unlock new items, skills, villagers, and creature visitors.

data.name: Vacation Cafe Simulator
data.shortDescription: Cozy Italian Vacation Cafe 🏖️ No timers, No stress 😌 cook traditional dishes 🍝 upgrade and customize 🏠 just drink Prosecco 🥂 relax and grow your dream cafe ✨

data.name: Shelve the Potions!
data.shortDescription: Organize 2000+ potions on shelves after the witch's cats have knocked them over, using clues around an enchanted cellar. Learn strange symbols and decipher cryptic notes.

data.name: Heartopia
data.shortDescription: A multiplayer life simulation game crafted for creativity, freedom, and peace. Build your dream home, explore hobbies, and forge warm connections with friends in a cozy town.
